capabilities: Turn messages sent to a Telegram bot into vault notes
Process notes with AI providers for titles, formatting, categorization and image analysis
Transcribe voice, audio and video messages
Extract text locally from PDF, DOCX, XLSX, PPTX, EPUB, TXT, CSV and code files
Route messages to folders and templates with variables and distribution rules
extras: Mobile support is in beta, as are the Claude and Gemini providers. Catching up on messages sent while Obsidian was closed is desktop-only and needs your own Telegram api_id/api_hash; the Bot API limits file downloads to 20 MB. Secrets are encrypted in data.json and a pin code is recommended before cloud-syncing the vault.
intentEvidence: This plugin was inspired by and built upon obsidian-telegram-sync by soberhacker
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to turn Telegram messages into notes, so thoughts sent from a phone must be copied over manually.

summary: Telegram bot integration that saves messages sent to your own bot as vault notes, with optional AI processing, categorization and document text extraction.
